prs.tagLine: Exceptional City Living with Premium Amenities
prs.location:
The Docklands isn’t just a location. It’s a statement.

Once the engine room of Dublin’s industrial past, today it’s the city’s most dynamic neighbourhood where global tech meets local culture.

Living at The Carriageworks means being part of it. With the River Liffey beside you and the city centre a short walk away, everything Dublin offers is within reach.

2 Bedroom Apartment – Space to Live and Grow

Our two-bedroom apartments at The Carriageworks are ideal for sharers, families, or anyone needing extra space. 

Each home features a bright open-plan kitchen, dining, and living area, two spacious double bedrooms one ensuite, with built-in wardrobes, and a modern main bathrooms with rainfall shower and contemporary fixtures. A dedicated utility room with a washer/dryer makes everyday living easy, while smart heating controls and high-speed broadband ensure comfort and connectivity. These apartments offer the perfect balance of comfort, style, and convenience in a central Dublin location.


Residents enjoy a host of amenities designed to enhance your lifestyle:

-	Rooftop Wellness area: Wellness spaces for mind and body including a rooftop sauna and ice baths.
-	Premium Gym & Studio: Techno Gym equipment for all fitness levels.
-       Onsite Trainer and Dedicated Fitness Classes.
-       Dedicated Residents Padel Court Coming Soon in Q4 2026.
-	FREE High Speed WiFi: Seamless connectivity throughout the scheme.
-	Residents Club House & Co-Working Spaces: Socialise, work, or unwind.
-	Reception and Concierge: Professional support for residents.
-	Coffee Dock: Perfect for downtime and casual gatherings.
-	Resident App: Manage bookings and community updates from your phone.
-	Car Sharing Club: Sustainable transport options.
-	Community Events: Regular activities to connect and enjoy city life.
-	Pet Friendly: Your furry friends are welcome*

Coming Soon: Padel Court, Contrast Hydro Showers, Rooftop Games Area, Putting Green, Outdoor Kitchen, Private Bookable Kitchen.

—all designed to make city living easy, healthy, and enjoyable.
